cases.sentence: Обрати лицо твое на горы ___ и пророчествуй на них.
cases.translation: Set your face against Mount Seir and prophesy against it.
cases.explain: The verb пророчествуй (prophesy) requires accusative case for its object.

cases.sentence: И скажи ему: так говорит владыка Господь. Вот я против тебя, гора ___.
cases.translation: Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir.
cases.explain: Vocative address (direct address) uses nominative case.

cases.sentence: Я разрушу тебя и сделаю тебя пустынею, и узнаешь, что я Господь, когда я превращу тебя в ___.
cases.translation: I will turn you into a ruin.
cases.explain: The transitive verb превращу requires accusative case for its object.

cases.sentence: За то, что ты питал вражду против сынов Израиля во дни беды их, во ___ гибели их.
cases.translation: During the time of their calamity.
cases.explain: The accusative case with во indicates temporal extent: во время = during/at the time.

cases.sentence: Поэтому, клянусь жизнью моею, так говорит владыка Господь, я дам тебя под ___.
cases.translation: I will give you over to bloodshed.
cases.explain: The preposition под (under) requires accusative case with directional meaning.

cases.sentence: И кровь твоя будет преследовать тебя. Как ты не ненавидел кровопролития, так кровопролитие будет преследовать ___.
cases.explain: The transitive verb преследовать requires accusative case for its object.

cases.sentence: Я сделаю горы твои пусты, и ни один из них не будет ходить в ___.
cases.translation: No one will walk through them.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in/through) governs prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Я переполню холмы твои ___ от меча его.
cases.translation: I will fill your hills with the slain from his sword.
cases.explain: The verb переполню (I will fill) takes instrumental case for material substance.

reading.ru: Было ко мне слово Господа, говоря. Сын человеческий, обрати лицо твое на горы Сеира и пророчествуй на них.
reading.question: What did God command Ezekiel to do?
options: Set his face against Mount Seir and prophesy against it
Go to Mount Seir to trade
Build a city on Mount Seir
reading.correct: Set his face against Mount Seir and prophesy against it
reading.explain: God commanded Ezekiel to turn his face toward Mount Seir and prophesy judgment against it.

reading.ru: Вот я против тебя, гора Сеира, я протяну руку мою на тебя и сделаю тебя пустынею и опустошением.
reading.question: What does God threaten to do to Mount Seir?
options: Make it a desolation and a waste
Make it a center of worship
reading.correct: Make it a desolation and a waste
reading.explain: God declares He will make Mount Seir a desolation and ruin through His outstretched hand.

reading.ru: За то, что ты питал вражду против сынов Израиля во дни беды их.
reading.question: Why is God bringing judgment on Seir?
options: Because it harbored hostility toward Israel during their times of distress
reading.correct: Because it harbored hostility toward Israel during their times of distress
reading.explain: God holds Seir accountable for maintaining enmity toward Israel when they were in trouble.

reading.ru: Поэтому, клянусь жизнью моею, так говорит владыка Господь, ты будешь виновен в крови.
reading.question: What judgment does God pronounce on Seir?
options: Seir will be held guilty of bloodshed
reading.correct: Seir will be held guilty of bloodshed
reading.explain: God swears that Seir will answer for bloodshed because of its enmity toward Israel.

reading.ru: И кровь твоя будет преследовать тебя. Как ты не ненавидел кровопролития, так кровопролитие будет преследовать тебя.
reading.question: What will be the consequence of Seir's hostility?
options: Bloodshed will pursue them as they did not hate bloodshed
reading.correct: Bloodshed will pursue them as they did not hate bloodshed
reading.explain: Just as Seir did not shrink from violence, so violence will pursue them relentlessly.

reading.ru: Я сделаю горы твои пусты, и поселения твои не будут населены.
reading.question: What will become of Seir's cities and settlements?
options: The mountains will be desolate and the settlements uninhabited
They will flourish with many people
They will be fortified and strengthened
reading.correct: The mountains will be desolate and the settlements uninhabited
reading.explain: God will make Seir's mountains empty and no one will live in its cities anymore.
